claim: In the matching retail DLL, static Menu_SoundManager.Play_BGM (0x0600529E) has exact signature blob 00020111aa2411aa18, parameters (SYSTEM_SOUND bgm_type, PLAY_TYPE type), and an exact 309-byte body. It loads Menu_SoundManager.audioSrcInfo[0] into local0 and local0.sRefAudio into local1. When g_ProgressBGM_Continue is true, local1 is truthy through UnityEngine.Object.op_Implicit and local1.get_isPlaying() is true, the method returns immediately. Otherwise it calls canonical Menu_SoundManager.StopBGM. It then returns when audioClipInfo is null, signed bgm_type is raw 39 or greater, or audioClipInfo[bgm_type].audioClip compares equal to null through UnityEngine.Object.op_Equality. It calls canonical get__instance().MyMusic_Play(bgm_type,type) and returns when that call returns true. It then stores the original bgm_type into Menu_SoundManager.bgmKind. A switch over raw bgm_type-32 assigns local1.volume from Volume_BgmProgress for raw 32, Volume_BgmAdmission for raw 33, Volume_BgmBattle for raw 34 and Volume_BgmProgress for raw 35. The default path rewrites argument bgm_type to raw 32 and assigns local1.volume=1.0f. If raw PLAY_TYPE type equals 1 it sets local1.clip from audioClipInfo[bgm_type].audioClip, calls local1.Play(), sets local1.loop=true, and writes raw 0 to local0.fadeOutFrm and local0.fadeOutCnt. All other PLAY_TYPE values call local1.PlayOneShot(audioClipInfo[bgm_type].audioClip). FACT-0122, FACT-0130 and FACT-0131 pin canonical callers of this method.
